narrative.title: The Longest Cable Run
narrative.scenario: A fiber crew maps junction boxes laid out as a binary tree and must budget the longest possible cable run between any two boxes, following connections only. The run doesn't have to touch the head junction — sometimes the longest haul arcs between two deep branches. Every junction reports the two deepest descents around it, and the best combination anywhere wins the budget.
narrative.inputFormat: The root of a binary tree given as a level-order array where null marks a missing child.
narrative.outputFormat: Return an integer: the length (in edges) of the longest path between any two nodes.

testCases.explanation: The only two-node path is a single edge.

hintLevels: Level 1: The longest route at any junction bends through it — left depth plus right depth.
Level 2: Compute subtree heights bottom-up and record left + right at every node in a running maximum.
Level 3: The height you return is one more than the taller child, but the recorded candidate is left + right — don't mix the two.
